challenges.title: 6-month reference period, compensatory rest and NCHD requirements

items.title: 6-month reference period for the 48-hour limit
items.text: For medical staff, Section 15 of the OWTA 1997 allows a reference period of 6 rather than 4 months for calculating the average 48-hour week — almost impossible to track by hand across changing shift patterns.

items.title: Compensatory rest under COP8
items.text: If a rest period is shortened, the WRC Code of Practice on Compensatory Rest Periods (COP8) requires a compensatory rest period — when and how it is granted must be documented.

items.title: NCHD Agreement: 10 consecutive duty days maximum
items.text: The HSE/IMO NCHD Agreement 2022, in force since January 2023, mandates rest for non-consultant hospital doctors after a maximum of 10 consecutive duty days, together with compensatory payments.

items.title: Compensatory rest under COP8 planned in

items.title: NCHD duty days kept in view
